rationale: The original short thesis relied on price trending steadily below the 5-minute 9-EMA, which has now failed as VOD reclaimed the 9-EMA ($13.29) and is currently trading at $13.31. After forming a double-bottom base at $13.22 on elevated volume, price is reversing sharply upward toward the $13.34 invalidation level while the broader market remains extremely strong (SPY +5.01%). Exiting now cuts the position ahead of the hard stop since the immediate downward momentum has broken.
